      • Our Story
      • The Voices of Nannup, Oral Histories Project
        • 👉 From Ireland to Nannup, discover Chris's remarkable community story.
        • 👉 Listen to Margaret's journey of sustainability, family and community.
        • 👉 Discover the strength behind Shirley's remarkable Nannup journey.
        • 👉 Hear Imelda's reflections on generations of life in Nannup.
        • 👉 Listen to Woggy and Ernest's stories from the timber industry.
        • 👉 Tune in to hear Val’s vivid reflection of life in Nannup
        • 👉 Join the Dunnet brothers journey enduring the spirit of Nannup’s farming families
        • 👉 Listen in as Tony brings Nannup’s past to life, one cream run, railway tale, and family story at a time
        • 👉 Don’t miss Val and John’s inspiring story on the land they’ve called home for 60 years
        • 👉 Take a moment to listen to Cheryle’s story in a rich tapestry of Nannup’s past
        • 👉 Tune in to hear Robert’s story where history, hardship, and heartfelt service come together
        • 👉 Listen to Leanne’s story of art, nature, and the heart of Nannup
        • 👉 Hear Vicki celebrate community spirit as it shines through every word
        • 👉 Join Pat as she shares a heartfelt connection to Nannup
        • 👉 Listen to Tracy’s story in a moving tribute to old Nannup
        • 👉 Listen to Jim's recollections from his grandfather about war, royalty, and the journey to Nannup
        • 👉 Tune in to hear Jim's story of forests, Thylacines, and the natural world
        • 👉 Listen to Maggie’s story of gardening, heritage, and the spirit of community
        • 👉 Tune in to hear John’s inspiring story of a life in the arts
        • 👉 Listen to Rob and his interpretation on art, loss, and life in Nannup
        • 👉 Don’t miss Michael’s story where practical wisdom meets poetry
        • 👉 Join Warren as he shares his journey from weekender to First Responder
        • 👉 Tune in on Kim's renditions on civic pride and the power of volunteering
        • 👉 Don’t miss the Holberry House story on gardens, trails, and the many hats of Louise Stokes
        • 👉 Join Wendy & Heather on a weekend of discovery at the Nannup Music Festival

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF ELECTORS

Thursday, January 29, 2026 - 06:00 PM

Location: Shirley Humble Room, 15 Adam Street, Nannup

Downloads

Agenda Annual Electors Meeting 2026 (486.32 KB)

Attachment 3.1 Minutes Annual General meeting of Electors 20 March 2025 (389.92 KB)

Attachment 4.1 Annual Report 2024-25 (2.16 MB)

Minutes Annual Electors Meeting 29 January 2026 (488.41 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Location: Council Chambers, 15 Adam Street, Nannup

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Annual General Meeting of Electors

Thursday, June 29, 2023 - 05:00 PM

In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995, Electors of the Shire of Nannup are herby notified that Council has resolved to hold its Annual General Meeting of Electors on Thursday 29 June 2023 at 5.00 pm in the Shire of Nannup Council Chambers, 15 Adam Street, Nannup.

Please follow the path to the back of the administration building to access the Shirley Humble Room.

Business to be conducted at the meeting will include:

  1. Shire President’s Report
  2. Chief Executive Officer’s Report;
  3. 2020/21 Auditor's Report;
  4. 2020/21 Annual Report incorporating Annual Financial Statements;
  5. 2021/22 Auditor’s Report;
  6. 2021/22 Annual Report incorporating Annual Financial Statements; and
  7. General Business.

For further information please contact the Shire on telephone 9756 1018 or email nannup@nannup.wa.gov.au

 

DAVID TAYLOR

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Public Copy_Minutes 23 November 2023_Ordinary Council Meeting (475.56 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Special Council Meeting

Tuesday, October 24, 2023 - 04:00 PM

NOTICE OF A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

A Special Meeting of the Shire of Nannup is to be held on Tuesday 24 October 2023 commencing at 4.00 pm in the Council Chambers, Adam Street, Nannup for:

  • The swearing-in of Returned Councillors
  • Elections of Shire President, Deputy Shire President, and appointment of Councillor representatives on Committees.

The swearing-in ceremony will be officiated by Sergeant Jeff Cooke, Acting Sergeant at Nannup Police Station.

David Taylor

Chief Executive Officer

Minutes_24 October 2023 Special Council Meeting (361.63 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Special Council Meeting

Thursday, June 1, 2023 - 04:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 15 Adam Street, Nannup

Special Council Meeting to be held Thursday 1 June 2023

 4.30pm in Council Chambers, 15 Adam Street, Nannup

 

The purpose of the meeting is for Council to consider:

  1. 2023/24 Differential Rates and Minimum Rates
  2. Shire of Nannup Seniors Housing Precinct

Agenda

Special Council Meeting Agenda_1 June 2023 (1.27 MB)

Attachment 10.2.1 - Seniors Housing Report (3.49 MB)

Minutes

Special Council Meeting Minutes_1 June 2023 (1.30 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Special Meeting of Council

Thursday, August 11, 2022 - 04:30 PM

Agenda

Agenda - 11 August 2022 Special Meeting of Council (1.10 MB)

Minutes

11 August 2022 SCM Minutes_PUBLIC COPY (1.14 MB)

Downloads

Attachment 11.1.1 - Differential Rating Proposal 2022/2023 Statement of Objectives & Reasons (825.18 KB)

Attachment 11.1.2 - Submissions (19.95 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

10 March 2022 Minutes_PUBLIC COPY_SCM (1.11 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Special Meeting of Council

Wednesday, February 16, 2022 - 04:00 PM

Agenda

PUBLIC COPY Agenda 16 February Special Council Meeting (981.84 KB)

Minutes

PUBLIC COPY_16 Feb 2022 SCM MINUTES (899.96 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, December 16, 2021 - 05:30 PM

Agenda

16 December 2021 OCM Agenda (1.19 MB)

December 2021 OCM Combined Attachments (24.16 MB)

Minutes

16 December 2021 OCM Minutes (1.23 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

25 November 2021 OCM Minutes (1.25 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, August 26, 2021 - 05:30 PM

Agenda

26 August 2021 Ordinary Meeting Agenda_PUBLIC COPY (1.31 MB)

Website Attachments_August 2021 (94.42 MB)

26 August PUBLIC COPY_Ordinary Council Minutes (1.41 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

July Combined Attachments (24.85 MB)

Minutes

Public Copy_22 July 2021 Minutes (1.37 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, May 27, 2021 - 05:30 PM

Agenda

27 May 2021 Agenda Attachments (50.35 MB)

27 May 2021 Agenda_Public Copy (1.34 MB)

Minutes

27 May 2021 Ordinary Meeting Minutes_Unconfirmed (1.35 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

22 April 2021 Ordinary Council Meeting Minutes (1.32 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Thursday, December 17, 2020 - 09:15 AM

Agenda

December 2020 Attachments (13.72 MB)

Minutes

17 December 2020 Minutes (957.58 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, October 22, 2020 - 09:15 AM

Agenda

22 October Agenda_Public Copy (1.12 MB)

Combined October 2020 Agenda Attachments_Public Copy (45.61 MB)

Minutes

22 October 2020 Minutes Public Copy (1.13 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, August 27, 2020 - 09:00 AM

Agenda

27 August 2020 Agenda_Public Copy (842.57 KB)

August 2020 Combined Agenda Attachments (14.40 MB)

Minutes

27 August 2020 Minutes (852.61 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.

Special Meeting of Council

Thursday, April 9, 2020 - 09:25 AM

Agenda

Agenda & Attachment (1.05 MB)

Minutes

9 April Special Meeting Minutes_Public Copy (1.13 MB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.

Ordinary Meeting of Council

Thursday, February 27, 2020 - 08:35 AM

Agenda

Agenda Public Copy February 2020 (964.54 KB)

February 2020 Combined Attachments (22.01 MB)

Minutes

February 2020 Minutes (797.74 KB)

The Shire of Nannup acknowledges the Wardandi and Bibbulmun people as the native title holders of the lands and waters in and around Nannup together with all native title holders throughout the Shire.
We pay respect to the Elders, past, present and emerging, of the Wardandi & Bibbulmun people and extend that respect to all Aboriginal Australians living within the Shire of Nannup.
